import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Convert 'Dt_Customer' to datetime format
df['Dt_Customer'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Dt_Customer'], format='%d-%m-%Y')

# Create a new column for customer tenure in years
df['Customer_Tenure'] = (pd.Timestamp('now') - df['Dt_Customer']).dt.days / 365

# Calculate average spending on different products
df['Total_Spending'] = df[['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 
                           'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']].sum(axis=1)

# Create a scatter plot of Income vs Total Spending colored by Marital Status
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='Income', y='Total_Spending', hue='Marital_Status', palette='viridis', alpha=0.7)

# Add a regression line
sns.regplot(data=df, x='Income', y='Total_Spending', scatter=False, color='red', line_kws={'linewidth':1.5})

# Customize the plot
plt.title('Income vs Total Spending by Marital Status')
plt.xlabel('Income')
plt.ylabel('Total Spending')
plt.legend(title='Marital Status', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
plt.grid(True)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the plot as 'output.png'
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
